methodology.how: C0 is view-compiled, not authored. infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py @ec0408628a scans the live AWS estate and the repo source tree and materializes each discovered object as a row in the Iceberg table graph_nodes carrying node_id, node_type and a JSON props blob (:271, :319, :332). A separate build projects that table into the local kuzu database for traversal, creating CloudNode with PRIMARY KEY(node_id) (:1448-1450). The ROLE vocabulary lives in the rule bank and is COMPOSED onto the node population by node_bindings; it is not a field the producer writes. So the producer ORIGINATES the node_type vocabulary (58 distinct types live) while the rule bank DECLARES the role vocabulary, and node_bindings is the only thing joining them.

key.identity_space: node_id -- a HETEROGENEOUS space with no single grammar: AWS ARNs for cloud resources, repo-relative paths for source objects, S3 key glob patterns for data objects, Microsoft 365 item ids for knowledge objects. One column, several grammars, joined only by the producer's own construction.
key.key_expression: str(node["id"]) -- literally `str(n.get("id", ""))` at infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py:332 @ec0408628a, written into the graph_nodes column node_id, which the kuzu projection then declares PRIMARY KEY(node_id) at :1450. The expression is the producer's stringification of each discovered object's own `id` field; it invents no key and normalises nothing.
key.evidence: STABILITY IS UNEXERCISED, and 'unknown' is the enum's honest member, not a shrug: proving it would need the same object observed across TWO derives with its node_id compared, and this carding read ONE vintage. The expression is READ AT SOURCE (derive_runner.py:332 and :1450 @ec0408628a), not inferred from prose. Two live arms at the vintage above: nodes with node_id = '' -> 0 (the `""` default in the expression exists in code but no node reaches the graph carrying it); count(n)=27084 and count(DISTINCT n.node_id)=27084. ⛔ THE SECOND ARM IS WEAKER THAN IT LOOKS AND IS RECORDED AS SUCH: node_id is the PRIMARY KEY at :1450, so a producer-side duplicate would be REJECTED AT LOAD rather than recorded. Distinct==rows in the graph therefore cannot evidence that the producer emits unique ids -- it is a control downstream of the corruption it would need to see. Producer-side collision rate is UNMEASURED.

failure_mode.evidence: The 6,298 of 27,084 nodes (23.3%) outside the role mapping are reachable by node_type but invisible to any role-keyed traversal, and nothing in the result distinguishes them from absence. Consequence for consumers: a clean zero from C0 is NOT evidence of absence, and any role-keyed claim spans at most 76.7% of the population and must print that denominator.
failure_mode.returns_on_failure: An EMPTY RESULT SET with no diagnostic. A value-plane miss is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a genuine negative. A query returning zero rows for a role-keyed question cannot be told apart from (a) the object genuinely not existing, (b) the object existing under one of the 10 unbound node_types, or (c) the object existing but the derive not having reached it this vintage. All three render as an empty result set with no diagnostic.
silent_degrade_paths: a role-keyed traversal silently spans only the 76.7% mapped subset -- the 6,298 unmapped nodes are reachable by node_type but invisible to role, and nothing in the result says so
a node whose node_type is one of the 10 UNBOUND types returns nothing to any role query and is indistinguishable from a node that does not exist

verdict.why: Every one of the seven rows is worked and carries basis, evidence and owner; no row is blank or guessed, so this is not INCOMPLETE. The subject is usable as load-bearing substrate WITHIN stated limits, which is why QUALIFIED rather than SOUND. Four measured limits bound that use: (1) the role mapping is PARTIAL -- 6,298 of 27,084 nodes (23.3%) and 10 of 58 node_types sit outside it, so any role-keyed claim spans at most 76.7% and must print that denominator; (2) a value-plane miss is indistinguishable from a genuine negative, so a clean zero from C0 is not evidence of absence; (3) determinism and key stability are both UNEXERCISED and honestly marked unknown rather than assumed; (4) the key's uniqueness arm is structurally weak -- PRIMARY KEY(node_id) rejects producer-side duplicates at load, so the graph cannot show the collision rate it would need to prove. None of the four blocks use outright; each is a limit a consumer can respect if told, which is what this card does. NOT CLAIMED: that the 76.7% mapped subset is CORRECT -- this card measured mapping COVERAGE, never mapping CORRECTNESS.
